messages:
Maya: heads-up — release /release/2026.03.1 promotion blocked by CI. deploy-bot aborted auto-promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job=canary-smoke step=build:image-cache error=EACCES mount /var/lib/docker/cache: permission denied (mount syscall). logs: https://ci.internal/4951239999/logs
Jordan: ugh. is this the same cache-dirs-perm issue we've seen on self-hosted runners?
Priya: looks similar but stacktrace shows `fuse: mount failed: operation not permitted` not a flaky network. Runner kernel upgrade last night? cc @Chen
Chen: runner nodes had a kubelet restart during maintenance window at 02:15 UTC, maybe docker fuse mounts didn't recover. checking node events now.
Chen: node/runner-12 event: kubelet restarted, docker service restarted, docker-cache PVC reattached as root:root, but mount propagation lost.
Maya: can we re-run just the canary build? or do we need to pin to last-good image to unblock promote?
Jordan: re-run likely to hit same failure unless mount is fixed. ops-bot can we cordon runner-12 and drain?
ops-bot: Command queued: cordon runner-12 -> drained 2026-03-05T03:02:10Z. New runners spun up: runner-24, runner-25.
Priya: started a manual rebuild of job canary-smoke on runner-24 (buildkite: #2026.03.1-rc5).
deploy-bot: Rebuild queued: buildkite.com/redwood/canary-smoke #4521 (rerun by Priya).
Jordan: if that passes, we'll still have to validate artifact digest for promote. last-good image is `redwood/service:2026.03.0-candidate-7` — option to pin to that and resume?
Maya: prefer to wait for rebuild unless it's blocked for >30m. timeline?
Chen: log from new runner shows mount successful but warnings about owner mismatch. artifact upload succeeded to registry but upload step took +40s.
Priya: rebuild passed unit and smoke, but integration job timed out on e2e-runner due to flaky infra. rerun integration on runner-25.
Jordan: we should also add a short-term workaround: set `CI_DOCKER_CACHE_MOUNT_OPTS=shared,nosuid` for canary jobs to avoid permission error on reattached PVC. small config change in buildkite pipeline.
Maya: I'm ok with that as a temporary patch. Priya — can you patch pipeline and kick the promote after integrations pass?
Priya: patch pushed: pipeline.yml set CI_DOCKER_CACHE_MOUNT_OPTS env. kicking integration rerun.
deploy-bot: Integration job succeeded. All checks green except perf-regressions (non-blocking). Auto-promote will retry in 2m.
deploy-bot: Promotion resumed: promoted tag=release/2026.03.1 -> prod, note=manual-unblock-after-cache-mount-fix.
Maya: rolling release now. leaving note for release-notes: mention transient CI cache mount issue and short-term mount opt change.
Chen: I'll follow up with infra to investigate persistent mount propagation fix (possible kubelet mount-propagation bug after restarts). filing infra ticket: INFRA-3129.
Jordan: also temp pinned baseimage? not needed since artifacts are same digest. no baseimage pin.
Maya: thanks team. Postmortem: if promote fails again, pin to last-good and open rollback. For now, release complete. :tada:
